    Indicator cochains: relativity and characters #

    Two facts used in the proofs of Propositions 11.2 and 11.3 (binary-families.tex):

    • the supported cochains are normalized S-relative (their values vanish on identity inputs and they commute with the vertex idempotents);
    • "Every indicator has a single positive character c_E = ℓ(r*s) − ℓ(r) − ℓ(s) = ℓ(q_y). All pairs in one class E have the same character, since each equation a_z = a_{z'} comes from a homogeneous cocycle equation." (pairChar_edge)
